title: LiveAgentSandboxWorkerRequest
description: live.agent-sandbox-worker-request@1 (Agent Streams S6): the body of POST /api/streams/agent/:id/plays/worker on OpenVibe.Live (capability live.agent_sandbox.register). It is the sandbox worker's own check-in: the worker says it is there and reports the isolation facts Live requires, and Live derives health only from that check-in (it stores no endpoint and never calls the worker). Only a first-party service token whose principal holds live.agent_sandbox.register may send it, and it names the person it works for in X-OV-Subject, who must own the stream. The owner's session, a desk ticket and a person token are refused. Live counts a check-in within the last minute as alive and requires isolation to say exactly: host_network false, credentials false, profile false, egress_proxy true, workspace 'ephemeral'. The worker may report more than these five facts (its own checks, limits and versions); Live reads only the five and stores the report it was given. A worker that cannot say each of the five is not registered at all.

worker_id.description: The worker's name in its own records; not a secret and not an address.

service.description: The worker implementation that checked in (`codes-sandbox` for OpenVibe.Codes').

ready.description: The worker's own view of its health; Live's health is the check-in plus the isolation report, never this flag alone.

reasons.description: Why the worker says it is not ready (its self-test's failures), for the owner's page.

checks.description: The worker's self-test: one boolean per check it ran (the network namespace, the egress refusals, the cleaned environment, the host files, the capabilities, seccomp, the cgroup limits, the wipe).

checked_at.description: When that self-test ran; null before the first one.

host_network.description: The sandbox has its own network namespace; it cannot reach the host's network.

credentials.description: No credential of the host, the worker or the person is inside the sandbox.

profile.description: No browser or desktop profile of the host's is mounted.

egress_proxy.description: Its only way out is the worker's proxy, which applies the egress guard.

workspace.description: The workspace is the sandbox's own and is gone with the wipe.

browser.description: Whether this worker has the optional headless browser.

capacity.description: How many sandboxes it may run at once.

at.description: When the worker assembled the report.
